title: The gray priest's barrow-doors blessing narrates the outcome immediately ('Far off, the stone doors grind open. No promise binds them shut.') and the Barrow Field room text shows the doors 'standing open into the dark' well before the actual mechanical seal-or-open choice is offered at the throne after resting the king. Had I later picked 'seal the barrow doors behind you' at the throne, the earlier narration would have directly contradicted the result.
where: Gray Chapel (talk to gray priest: 'a blessing for the barrow') / Barrow Field
